stops.name: Fljótavík
stops.detail: Especially since the beginning of the 20th century, the bays Fljótavík and Aðalvík have also been referred to as Hornstrandir.

stops.name: Aðalvík
stops.detail: The headland Straumnes forms the northwest of Hornstrandir, which lies north of the bay Aðalvík and west of the bays Rekavík and Fljótavík.

stops.name: Kögur
stops.detail: Originally, the western border of the area was the mountain Kögur north of the bay Fljótavík; in the east, Hornstrandir extended to the headland Geirólfsnúpur (also Geirólfsgnúpur) near the fjord Reykjarfjörður.

stops.name: Hornbjarg
stops.detail: The adjacent northern coastline of Hornstrandir was, especially in the past, referred to as Vestur-Strandir to the west of the cliffs Hornbjarg, while Austur-Strandir lies to the east of it.
